statement: The division bivouacked at 1 a. m. on 2 July about a mile from Gettysburg, east of the Emmitsburg road (the OCR prints Ernmitsburg).

source.author: Brig. Gen. Andrew A. Humphreys
source.quote: bivouacking at 1 a. m. on July 2 about 1 mile from Gettysburg
source.cite: OR Ser. I vol. 27 pt. 1, OR27-1-R158 Brig. Gen. Andrew A. Humphreys, p. 531

place.printed: about 1 mile from Gettysburg and eastward of the Ernmitsburg road

statement: The 11th Massachusetts reached Gettysburg at 2 a. m. on 2 July after marching through Emmitsburg.

source.author: Lieut. Col. Porter D. Tripp
source.quote: marched through Emmitsburg to Gettysburg, Pa., where we arrived at 2 a. m.
source.cite: OR Ser. I vol. 27 pt. 1, OR27-1-R162 Lieut. Col. Porter D. Tripp, p. ~549 (548-549)

statement: The 11th Massachusetts left Bridgeport at 7 a. m. on 1 July and marched through Emmitsburg toward Gettysburg.

source.author: Lieut. Col. Porter D. Tripp
source.quote: Left Bridgeport at 7 a. m. on July 1, and marched through Emmitsburg
source.cite: OR Ser. I vol. 27 pt. 1, OR27-1-R162 Lieut. Col. Porter D. Tripp, p. ~549 (548-549)

statement: The Third Brigade joined the division at 9 a. m. on 2 July, marching by the main road from Emmitsburg to Gettysburg.

source.author: Brig. Gen. Andrew A. Humphreys
source.quote: It marched by the main road from Emmitsburg to Gettysburg.
source.cite: OR Ser. I vol. 27 pt. 1, OR27-1-R158 Brig. Gen. Andrew A. Humphreys, p. 531

road.printed: the main road from Emmitsburg to Gettysburg

statement: The main road from Emmitsburg to Gettysburg of this passage is the gazetteer's Emmitsburg Road.

source.author: Brig. Gen. Andrew A. Humphreys
source.quote: It marched by the main road from Emmitsburg to Gettysburg.
source.cite: OR Ser. I vol. 27 pt. 1, OR27-1-R158 Brig. Gen. Andrew A. Humphreys, p. 531

reasoning: the report calls the road on the crest of the ridge "the Emmitsburg road" in the same account; the road from Emmitsburg to Gettysburg is that road

road_identification.printed_name: the main road from Emmitsburg to Gettysburg
road_identification.basis: the printed words describe the road that runs from Emmitsburg to Gettysburg; the same report names it the Emmitsburg road

statement: At an early hour on 2 July the division was massed near its bivouac, facing the Emmitsburg road.

source.author: Brig. Gen. Andrew A. Humphreys
source.quote: my division was massed in the vicinity of its bivouac, facing the Emmitsburg road
source.cite: OR Ser. I vol. 27 pt. 1, OR27-1-R158 Brig. Gen. Andrew A. Humphreys, p. 531

when.printed: At an early hour of the morning

place.printed: in the vicinity of its bivouac, facing the Emmitsburg road

statement: About 4 p. m. on 2 July the division moved forward so that its first line ran along the Emmitsburg road.

source.author: Brig. Gen. Andrew A. Humphreys
source.quote: so that the first line ran along the Emmitsburg road
source.cite: OR Ser. I vol. 27 pt. 1, OR27-1-R158 Brig. Gen. Andrew A. Humphreys, p. 532

to.printed: so that the first line ran along the Emmitsburg road

statement: The 11th Massachusetts moved to the front at 8 a. m. on 2 July, went into line of battle at 3 p. m. and was engaged until 8 p. m.

source.author: Lieut. Col. Porter D. Tripp
source.quote: The regiment was engaged with the enemy until 8 p. m.
source.cite: OR Ser. I vol. 27 pt. 1, OR27-1-R162 Lieut. Col. Porter D. Tripp, p. ~549 (548-549)

place.printed: to the front to support a line of skirmishers

statement: On the afternoon of 2 July the Fifth Excelsior (74th New York) was placed on the right of the First Brigade.

source.author: Col. William R. Brewster
source.quote: Lieut. Col. Thomas Holt commanding, was placed on the right of the First
source.cite: OR Ser. I vol. 27 pt. 1, OR27-1-R169 Col. William R. Brewster, p. ~558 (558-559)

place.printed: on the right of the First Brigade

statement: Shortly after midday on 2 July the division stood with the First Brigade in the front line, the Second in mass 200 yards behind it and the Third 200 yards behind the second.

source.author: Brig. Gen. Andrew A. Humphreys
source.quote: in line of battalions in mass 200 yards in rear of the first line
source.cite: OR Ser. I vol. 27 pt. 1, OR27-1-R158 Brig. Gen. Andrew A. Humphreys, p. 532

statement: At 3 a. m. on 7 July the division marched out on the Emmitsburg road.

source.quote: At 3 a. m. of the 7th, my division marched on the Emmitsburg road
source.cite: OR Ser. I vol. 27 pt. 1, OR27-1-R158 Brig. Gen. Andrew A. Humphreys, p. 536
